payload.title: Alexa M6: Roll out the skill to every Papyrus site (config-only)
payload.description:
Milestone 6. Every Papyrus site can turn on its own skill with config alone.

Scope:
- Confirm that a site needs only config: publication name, invocation name, icons, listing copy, plugin switch. Any per-site code found during the pilot becomes config.
- Invocation-name check for each site (Amazon's invocation-name rules; brand names that Alexa mispronounces, such as Anth.us, need a tested spoken form).
- Turn it on, certify and publish site by site. Anth.us goes last, after the edge check, and only with Ryan's go-ahead. Distinctive stays on hold unless Ryan releases it.

Done when: each site Ryan approves has a published skill, built from config only.
